surfaceMatrix.summary: Required facts are nonempty and the actual ordered cases are bound into the fixture and evaluation-input digests.
Quality, privacy, route, spend, retry, concurrency, timeout, and response-size limits fail closed.
Every attempt requires explicit provider, model, and status metadata; missing, cached, or inconsistent metadata remains incomplete.
Runner time, one-use same-invocation provenance, authenticated receipts, latest terminal attempts, and anti-rollback anchors are reverified.
Incomplete evidence cannot become recommendation input; the core helper is explicitly artifact-consistency-only until V1-07 composes receipt-authenticated authorization.

residualRisks: Live OpenRouter behavior remains outside offline CI and needs an explicit field-operation grant.
V1-07 must compose recommendation authorization with exact receipt and current-policy verification.
